column1: # Scenario coverage, parsed as data by tests/run.sh check-scenarios (every
# stage run checks it before running any group).
# Columns (tab-separated): scenario  covers  kind  group  case  owner
#   covers: a privacy-ops.tsv ID or variant:<name> from variants.tsv
#   owner:  baseline | transport | controller | installers | qualification
#   kind/group/case: a registered group and an existing t_* case (active), or
#     "-" in all three when a later owner must supply the proof (deferred).
# Every privacy op needs at least one row; every variant needs an active row.
# Stage 1 rows prove fixture and evidence capability; product-level proof of
# the same operation is a separate row owned by the sub-plan that builds it.
